```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const w = Math.min(width, 1000);
  const h = 400;
  const ctx = DOM.context2d(w, h);
  const canvas = ctx.canvas;

  // Quasihole follows the pointer. Rescale in case the canvas is CSS-transformed (reveal.js)
  let hole = [w / 2, h / 2];
  canvas.onpointermove = e => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    hole = [(e.clientX - r.left) * w / r.width, (e.clientY - r.top) * h / r.height];
  };

  // Only simulate while on screen (and on the current slide, in reveal.js)
  let onScreen = true;
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => onScreen = entry.isIntersecting);
  observer.observe(canvas);
  invalidation.then(() => observer.disconnect());
  const visible = () => {
    const slide = canvas.closest(".reveal .slides section");
    return onScreen && (!slide || slide.classList.contains("present"));
  };

  const particles = initParticles(512, w, h);
  while (true) {
    if (visible()) {
      // Read the input's value directly so that changing m doesn't restart the simulation
      step(particles, viewof inverseFilling.value, hole, w, h);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
      for (const [x, y] of particles) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, 4, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "red";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(hole[0], hole[1], 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    yield canvas;
  }
}
```
